meta.title: Director
meta.description: Pick a Short you love, and Director walks you through shooting your own take on it.

home.title: <line>Watch any Short.</line> <line>Shoot your own.</line>
home.subtitle: A friend on your phone helps you film it, shot by shot.

hero.ask: Let's start at the market. Ready when you are!
hero.adapt: Inside it is! Your window light looks great.
hero.caption: Director on your phone: it asks for the market, you'd rather stay in, and the shot moves to your window.

xray.title: How Director reads a Short
xray.body: Gemini watches the Short once and writes a plan for every shot: the framing, the pose, how to hold the phone and what to say.
xray.caption: The plan Gemini 4 Argon wrote for “{title}”: {shots, plural, one {# shot} other {# shots}}, each with its framing, pose, camera move and lines.

steps.title: From watching to posting, in three steps

index.title: Pick a Short
index.body: Start from one that's ready to shoot, or paste the link of a Short you love. Gemini works out every shot.

shoot.title: Shoot it with Director
shoot.body: The camera opens on you and Director talks you through each shot: where to stand, how to hold the phone, what to say. Say it your own way.

publish.title: Post it to YouTube Shorts
publish.body: Director picks your best takes and writes the post, credits included, for your channel.

proof.title: Every shot, timed to the original
proof.body: This Short, and the shots Gemini found in it. Play it and follow along.

argon.name: Gemini 4 Argon on Vertex AI
argon.use: Watches each Short and writes its shot-by-shot plan.

flash.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash on Vertex AI
flash.use: Checks your scene and reviews every take.

live.name: Gemini Live API
live.use: Directs you by voice and sees your camera while you film.

tts.name: Gemini text-to-speech
tts.use: Gives Director its voice while you film.

nanoBanana.name: Nano Banana on Vertex AI
nanoBanana.use: Drew the storyboard card of every shot in the templates.

veo.name: Veo on Vertex AI
veo.use: Made the preview clip of every shot in the templates.

storage.name: Cloud Storage
storage.use: Keeps your takes and finished videos.

cloudRun.name: Cloud Run
cloudRun.use: Runs the indexer, where Gemini watches each Short.

computeEngine.name: Compute Engine
computeEngine.use: Runs Director's API, its line to Gemini Live and the job queues.

bigquery.name: BigQuery
bigquery.use: Logs each Short Director indexes, each shoot it directs and every take review's score.

youtube.name: YouTube Data API
youtube.use: Brings in the Shorts you pick.

signIn.name: Sign in with Google
signIn.use: Signs you in with your Google account.

templates.title: Six Shorts, ready to shoot
templates.body: Every account starts with these templates, already broken into shots by Gemini 4 Argon.
templates.meta: {shots, plural, one {# shot} other {# shots}}, {seconds, number, ::0.0} s
templates.credit: The Shorts shown belong to their creators and play from YouTube.

platforms.title: For platforms
platforms.body: Everyone who watches a Short is one tap from making their own. Director's planning, live direction and take reviews run behind one API, so a video app could put “Shoot your own” under every Short.

intro.title: Let's shoot this together
intro.first: Director sees your camera and hears you while you get set, and talks you through each shot. A take records only when you tap the shutter. Your browser asks for the camera and microphone next.
intro.again: Director sees and hears you while you get set. A take records only when you tap the shutter.
intro.rollFirst: Director records the whole time you're shooting, chat included, so it can find your best moments. Only the clips you use go in your video. Pause any time. Your browser asks for the camera and microphone next.
intro.rollAgain: Director records the whole time you're shooting, chat included. Only the clips you use go in your video. Pause any time.
